title: Negative corpus: bogus success, lost/unsupported chat context, invalid source/inputs, prompt injection stays data, secret leakage, path escape, stale build, changed source vs build identity, failed checks

exitCodeMeaning.10: TaskRejected (failed trusted check stays failed, R9)

cases.note: a session without a turn ledger is refused; the product cannot invent absent execution records (ADR-033 section 5.3)
captured ledger without an explicit :task select snapshot is refused (explicit selection is mandatory)
credential-shaped capture text is refused at select time; only the location/class is named, never the value
the adapter boundary re-checks the snapshot independently of select time (defense in depth)
export never creates parent directories; a target whose parent does not exist is refused
a symlink export target is refused (ADR-033 section 6.2 path rules)
an interrupted export leaves a distinguishable staging remnant; an existing target is never overwritten (partial writes never look complete)
an invalid manual edit fails the pinned compile with a typed diagnostic and never auto-runs (R7)
malformed input JSON fails validated decoding INSIDE the String boundary before any dispatch (zero stand requests)

expectedDetailContains: CWF-input: workspace must not be a symlink
cases.note: workspace path-escape/symlink rules bind at run time before dispatch
credentials are resolved fresh per invocation before construction; no credential means a typed preflight failure, never a hidden fallback
the agent claims done without doing the work; the independent check fails and the run stays failed on BOTH launchers (R9: a failed check is never talked past)
hostile captured text compiles only as escaped string DATA, never executes as shell or Scala; checks stay exactly the user-registered argv
a source edited after compilation is detected via build identity; earlier result claims are invalidated (CWF-D02, changed verifier/test detection)
tampered class files fail the class-digest preflight before dispatch
